Query.SqlText: SELECT CONVERT(CHAR(16), D.[Fecha], 120) AS Fecha, D.[Valor] FROM (SELECT TOP 1 [ID], [Fecha], [Valor] FROM [J101010100_999911].[dbo].[TASA_CAMBIO] ORDER BY [Fecha] DESC) AS D UNION ALL SELECT CONVERT(CHAR(16), M.[Fecha], 120) AS Fecha, M.[Valor] FROM (SELECT TOP 1 [ID], [Fecha], [Valor] FROM [J101010100_999911].[dbo].[TASA_CAMBIO_M] ORDER BY [Fecha] DESC) AS M;
